For business

Give the busywork to an agent.

Inbox triage, scheduling, follow-ups, research, and the ops work that eats a small team’s week, handled by agents your team builds with Archie, each one running on its owner’s computer.

What it handles

The work that slows a small team down.

None of it is hard. All of it takes time. An agent does the repetitive middle of each of these, and your team only touches the part that needs a person.

Inbox & Customer TriageSorts what needs you now and drafts on-brand replies for the rest

How it works

One agent per teammate, on their own computer.

Archie is our desktop app for building personal AI agents. In a business, that means each person gets an agent shaped to their role, not one shared bot in somebody else’s cloud.

Shaped to each role

The person on support gets an agent that triages the inbox and drafts replies. The owner gets one that chases follow-ups and preps the weekly numbers. Same app, different agents, each running on its owner’s computer.

We never hold your conversations

Customer lists, invoices, inboxes: your business data stays on your computers, in your custody. Your agents talk to the AI company directly on your own accounts (the starter credits a new install begins with are the one exception, and they end the moment a teammate connects yours). Our servers hold each teammate’s email address, plan, and paid add-ons. Never a conversation. The whole outbound list is on the Trust page.

It can’t email your customers or spend your money

Archie can draft and send email and change a connected calendar, but only after you approve that exact action: it proposes, you approve, then it acts. It has no ability to spend money or make a purchase, and that doesn’t exist in the app. An agent speaks only in the chats you connect it to, and only to the one person who paired with it. The honest, current list is on our Trust page.

And if Archie can’t do it yet, whether that’s a tool we don’t connect to or a way of working that’s particular to your shop, tell us and we’ll build the add-on. It becomes a marketplace listing too, so the one we build for you helps the next business as well.

Guided setup

Rather have us walk your team through it?

You can set all of this up yourself, and Archie is built for that. But plenty of owners would rather have someone alongside them the first time. We get on a call with you and your team, build the agents together on your computers, connect accounts with your approval, test everything, and fine-tune after launch. The full process is on How It Works.

No two businesses need the same thing, so we price by the hour rather than by the job, and the three costs below are the whole list.

Guided sessions

$250 a session, and each session runs an hour. A bigger setup takes more sessions, never a higher rate. We scope how many on the free discovery call.

Archie

Archie Business is $99 a month or $999 a year, one plan for the team’s shared agent with no seat count, a separate cost from guided setup. Archie is in testing and not for sale yet. See where it stands →

The AI model

Each teammate’s agent runs on their own pay-as-you-go account with the AI company: typically a few dollars a month, billed straight to them.
